thread:
maria: quick check — we're seeing the v2 deprec rollout triggering more fallbacks than expected. before we flip the console banner, can we enumerate rollback scenarios + a minimal metric set to decide when to revert? cc @jon @kevin

jon: can you paste a couple of failing request samples? is this header negotiation (x-redwood-api-version) or auth/client-side mismatch?

maria: mostly header negotiation + some tenants hitting 429s after fallback. sample log snippet: 
```
2026-03-20T14:02:11Z router: request id=rcpt_8a3, tenant=ten_****, header=x-redwood-api-version=2 -> routed v2, fallback -> v1, fallback_reason=HANDSHAKE_MISMATCH, latency=220ms
2026-03-20T14:02:12Z router: request id=rcpt_8b4, tenant=ten_****, header=x-redwood-api-version=2 -> routed v2, resp 429 after fallback
```

kevin: to be actionable we need 3 things asap:
- a rolling counter of fallback events (by reason)
- distinct tenant count for those fallbacks
- a tail latency signal per tenant (p95/p99) after fallback

tara: product would like a single-console "rollback risk" card and a soft-rollback button (route traffic back to v1 for 10m). what telemetry powers a safe single-click UI?

li: quick proposal for queries & alerts:
- ops metric (simple curl):
```
curl -s 'https://ops.internal/metrics?filter=event:fallback&since=15m' | jq '.events | map(select(.reason=="HANDSHAKE_MISMATCH")) | length'
```
- SQL to count distinct tenants:
```
SELECT count(DISTINCT tenant_id) AS affected_tenants
FROM request_events
WHERE fallback_reason IS NOT NULL
  AND ts > now() - interval '1 hour';
```
- alert rule: fallback_count > 50 && affected_tenants > 5 in 15m

jon: add a histogram of cache/prefix hit-rate before vs after fallback. if cache locality drops that's a big cost/regression signal. also want per-tenant recent deploy/version handshake distribution.

sam: we should backfill two weeks of slow-path/fallback data so we can compare baseline -> rollouts. I'll spin a job to export logs to workspace metrics.

deploy-bot: started deployment: metric/rollbacks.handoff.counter v1 -> v2 at 6912345700 (CI job #1823) :white_check_mark:

maria: can we make a console table that shows top-10 affected tenants (masked ids) + simple action links: "contact" / "soft-rollback" / "grant-grace"? product wants it in the deprec rollout card.

kevin: note on thresholds: our recommended temporary alarm is: 
- rolling_fallback_count >= 50 (15m)
- distinct_affected_tenants >= 5 (15m)
- any tenant p99_latency delta > 2x baseline -> immediate manual rollback

li: metric definition example to add to metrics repo: 
```
{
  "name": "platform.fallbacks.count",
  "labels": ["reason","tenant_masked","version_target"],
  "type": "counter",
  "description": "count of requests that fell back from requested version to alternate version"
}
```

maria: perfect. i'll file a short runbook with the threshold rules above and create a dashboard ticket. assigning to @jon and @li to add queries + top-10 widget. tagging @oncall-bot to watch the 2pm-6pm window today.

oncall-bot: paging oncall — watch thread 6912345678 for rollback alarms (thresholds: fallback_count=50, affected_tenants=5)

jon: will do a quick PR for the console widget (masked ids + contact link). estimate ~2h to wire alerts into existing deprec card.

sam: i'll also queue a backfill job and export to metrics topic so dashboards show 14d trends.

maria: thanks everyone. if we hit the alarm we'll do a soft rollback first, wait 30m, then full rollback if still bad. i'll post runbook steps here once created. :thumbsup:
